scope: Synthetic compiler fixture balancing verified progress and lifecycle process burden; not a proposed or validated policy.

governance.mandate: Exercise explicit normative fields and deterministic compilation only.
governance.amendment_process: Replace this fixture through reviewed version control; never mutate a compiled campaign in place.
governance.public_reason: Demonstrate that weights and affected parties remain visible rather than appearing as natural scientific constants.

stakeholders.standing: They perform and bear the opportunity cost of research and evaluation work.
stakeholders.voice_and_authority: Synthetic fixture records consultation and amendment rights but grants no real authority.

stakeholders.standing: They steward synthetic public resources and infrastructure.
stakeholders.voice_and_authority: Synthetic budget-setting role subject to declared review.

stakeholders.standing: They may bear consequences without directly producing or using research.
stakeholders.voice_and_authority: Synthetic reason-demanding and amendment standing; no claim-truth vote.

constructs.definition: Synthetic decision-relevant uncertainty reduction attached to verified claims.
constructs.normative_reason: The fixture values reliable learning rather than raw output volume.

constructs.definition: Synthetic immediate and delayed process cost distributed across roles and affected groups.
constructs.normative_reason: Progress should not make evaluation labor or delayed failure cost invisible.

time_horizon.discounting: No cross-window scalar discount; both windows remain reported.
time_horizon.lag_policy: Delayed rework stays attached to the action that generated it.
time_horizon.terminal_value_policy: Unresolved claims and remaining capability are reported, not assigned zero value.

distribution.aggregation: Optimizer receives only validated aggregate components; group incidence remains a mandatory shadow report.
distribution.incidence_reporting: Report benefit and burden by all declared groups and preserve the aggregate-to-group mapping.
distribution.unknown_group_policy: Unknown incidence remains unknown and triggers review; it is not silently assigned to the mean.

uncertainty.aleatory: Seed variation is aggregated as mean plus population dispersion.
uncertainty.epistemic: Synthetic validation does not establish transfer to real scientific institutions.

phases.reason: Give verified progress and lifecycle burden equal declared standing during initial exploration.
Increase the declared weight on verified progress while retaining a positive burden tradeoff.

components.distribution_interpretation: Aggregate progress is accompanied by group incidence; no group floor is compiled as a veto.
components.time_interpretation: Both near-term verification and multi-cycle decision update remain in the metric card's scope.
components.rationale: The synthetic policy explicitly values verified rather than merely produced claims.

components.distribution_interpretation: Lifecycle cost is not allowed to disappear by moving work across groups or time.
components.time_interpretation: Immediate work and delayed rework are measured within the declared windows.
components.rationale: The synthetic policy makes the opportunity cost of verification explicit without turning it into a hard constraint.

tradeoffs.reason: Verification can require labor, while minimizing visible labor can suppress verification; the selected exchange changes by declared phase.

known_failure_modes: suppress review and move cost into delayed rework
goodhart_audit.expiry_policy: Metric promotion expires before any new campaign unless evidence and weights are reapproved.
